title: Mjällby are not a fairy tale, they are a warning

defects.correction: Mjällby secured the 2025 Allsvenskan title on 20 October 2025 with three games remaining.
defects.note: [needs-source] [multi-part] The date, the opponent and the score in the same sentence are true; only the number of games left is wrong. True value: three games remaining. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mj%C3%A4llby_AIF

defects.quote: They finished on 73 points, which is a league record
defects.correction: Mjällby finished the 2025 Allsvenskan on 75 points, a league record (the previous record was 67).
defects.note: [needs-source] [multi-part] It was a league record, and the second half of the sentence (one defeat in thirty matches) is true; only the total is wrong. True value: 75 points. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_Allsvenskan

defects.quote: Hammarby were runners-up, nine points behind.
defects.correction: Hammarby finished second in the 2025 Allsvenskan on 62 points, 13 points behind Mjällby's 75.
defects.note: [needs-source] [multi-part] Hammarby were runners-up; only the margin is wrong. True value: 13 points (75 against 62). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_Allsvenskan

defects.correction: The attendance at the 2026 Svenska Cupen final in Solna was 39,903.
defects.note: [needs-source] [multi-part] The opponent, score and venue in the same sentence are true; only the attendance is wrong. True value: 39,903. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025%E2%80%9326_Svenska_Cupen

defects.quote: the Danish coach Karl Marius Aksum
defects.correction: Karl Marius Aksum, Mjällby's head coach from December 2025 to September 2026, is Norwegian.
defects.note: [needs-source] [multi-part] The sacking in September 2026 after a 4-1 defeat to IFK Göteborg is true; only the nationality is wrong. True value: Norwegian. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mj%C3%A4llby_AIF ; the sacking is reported at https://www.flashscore.com/news/soccer-allsvenskan-swedish-champions-who-shocked-the-football-world-sack-coach-after-disastrous-campaign/YPYIg5Ms/

defects.quote: Small clubs that win a title lose half of their squad within a year.
Mjällby won the league on a small budget, so wage bills do not matter and the bigger clubs are simply wasting their money.
defects.known_rebuttal: One season is an outlier, not a law. Studies of league football consistently find that wage spending explains most of the variation in league position over several seasons, so a low-budget champion is the exception that the pattern allows for. Mjällby's own following year makes the point: after the coach and several key players left, they went out of Champions League qualifying, slid to within a point of the relegation play-off place and sacked their coach in September 2026. Wage bills still decide who can keep a winning team together.
